title: Flowering Meadows

fields.label: Purpose
fields.value: Flowers, Dye Machine/Press Machine, Trees, Ores, Butterflies, Flora Laura

body:
Description

The Flowering Meadows is a subregion located in Finlay Island. It is located to the left of Finlay's beach, and behind the Resource Hub. It requires explosives, two Small Bombs to be exact to enter. There is a entrance on the other side of Flowering Meadows that doesn't need any explosives to enter.

Stores and Locations

The Flowering Meadows contains only one shop, called Flora Laura.

Flora Laura is a shop that mainly sells items that relate to Flowers, such as the Dye Machine and Press Machine, Jars, Fabric Rolls, etc. The also contains the four towers required to obtain the Petalfall Axe.

Species of Trees

The Flowering Meadows contain many different types of trees, most notably Sakura trees, but it also contains Birch, Oak, Willow trees and uniquely the Olivine Clover.

The Sakura and Willow trees are more efficient ways to earn money, as they sell more money than the beginner trees.

Mining

Common Ores

The Flowering Meadows contain many different stone nodes, such as the Lightslate and Beigeslate nodes but also contain Marble nodes on the higher parts of the Flowering Meadows, around Flora Laura.

In addition, many different common ores spawn in the Flowering Meadows, such as Inkstone, Copper, Tin, Pyrite, Iron, Gold, Rose Gold and exclusive to Marble, Quartz.

Rare Ores

Rare Ores can spawn in the Flowering Meadows as well, such as Rosa Flama Quartz being exclusive to Marble nodes. The Flowering Meadows can also contain Adurite, Mythriland Magnetite, which is exclusive to Lightslate and only spawns at night (assumption).

New Ores

Amethyst ore can be found in marble stones. Amethyst ore looks like small purple crystals in marble. Also, you can see the blue stones from bloomite, this ore looks like little blue flowers.

Flowers/Fruits

Flowers

Tulips are flowers that are the only and exclusive to the Flowering Meadows. These consist of Red, Orange, Green, Blue and Purple tulips. These flowers are also sold at Flora Laura.

Previously mentioned, Flora Laura also contains flowers that you can buy. They are the previously mentioned tulips, Sunflowers, Daisies and Roses. You can also buy already dyed tulips in a Jar.

Fruits

Only one type of Fruit can be found in the bushes of the Flowering Meadows, being the Blueberry. You can also find fruits in the trees of the Flowering Meadows, such as Pears, Apples and the Golden Apples (assumption)
